title: Polar imagery from a tile service

dataset.name: NASA GIBS EPSG:3031 imagery (or LIST Tasmania AerialPhoto2026 WMTS), warped in the browser to polar stereographic

left.label: warp: ortho-cog-viewer (WMTS/XYZ source draped on a mesh in EPSG:3031)
left.note: Permalink pending: GIBS EPSG:3031 or LIST AerialPhoto2026 WMTS on the polar stereographic preset.

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: gridlook has no XYZ/WMTS/ArcGIS tile ingestion, and its projection list is d3-geo's, so a tile service in EPSG:3031 cannot be loaded or viewed in its native CRS.

gap: Tile services and arbitrary projected CRSs are outside gridlook's model; it starts from lon/lat (or 3857) arrays. Both sides drape (texture over a mesh vs cells on a sphere), so the difference here is purely what can be ingested and which CRS the view can take.
bridge: A shared tile-source module (XYZ, WMTS GetCapabilities, ArcGIS cached) that both shells can use, and crsDefinition as a common CRS authority with proj4js/proj-wasm behind it.
